title: Fleeing to Christ for every need
english: [If we are in pain] in soul, let us follow the physician of knowledge. If we hunger, let us receive the bread. If we have been put to death, let us take the resurrection. If we have grown old in ignorance, let us ask for wisdom from wisdom itself.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in paralyticum juxta piscinam jacentem u02-rem-early
orientation: Cyril is closing his homily by urging his hearers to flee to Christ for every need, and this section lists the needs and the corresponding gifts to seek from him.

title: Apology for length
english: But our discourse has stretched on at length. And perhaps we have become a hindrance to the fatherly teaching.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in paralyticum juxta piscinam jacentem u02-rem-mid
orientation: Cyril pauses after a long chain of exhortations to acknowledge that his discourse has run long and may have delayed the father's teaching.

title: Doxological close
english: But the time now calls us to listen to greater words, so that, having been benefited by greater works, we may send up doxology to God through our deeds—to whom be glory, now and always and unto the ages of the ages. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in paralyticum juxta piscinam jacentem u02-rem-close
orientation: Cyril is closing the homily, turning from his long discourse to a final call to hear greater words and send up glory to God through deeds.
